text: Formula-Constrained Economic Systems Without Governance Voting identifies participation asymmetry, governance capture, coercion, and long-term instability as structural limits of voting-based governance in decentralized digital systems. This is consistent with Kaal's narrower decision to leave the UDLC governance architecture unspecified. The proposition does not establish that no voting design can meet the UDLC requirements or validate a formula-constrained alternative.
